name: The Office of Krampus
objective: The Director returns — alone, unarmored, and not to fight for the bells. He fights to test whether you understand what they are for.
intro: He steps out of the dark with no crimson uniform, no insignia, no escape route prepared. Just an old man and his Houndoom.
dialogue: Director Krampus: "You rang my bell for me. Now let me show you what it was for."
Director Krampus (defeated): "Magnificent. Now listen — because this time I am not your enemy."
lore_discovery: Krampus explains the final truth: the Chorus cannot be prevented, only timed. The seal is failing. Ring the Chorus wrongly and the sleeper wakes in rage; ring it rightly and it wakes — or sleeps — in peace. He kneels. The office of Krampus passes its judgment to the player.
